method_notes: Targeted national pass for UK performance venues with capacity >= 1,000, run 2026-09-20 against the existing 642-venue census. RECONCILIATION: research/major-event-venues/uk-major-event-census-01/venues.json was parsed programmatically (never eyeballed) and every existing canonical_name + alternative_names + city combination was extracted before any candidate was written. The file grew from 642 to 676 records while this pass was running, so the de-duplication was re-run against the final 676-record state across ALL venue_types (not just performance types) using normalised name matching that strips punctuation, case and a leading definite article. That second pass caught four candidates already present under conference/multi-purpose classifications - Central Hall Westminster (London), Tobacco Dock (London), Edinburgh Corn Exchange (Edinburgh) and McEwan Hall (Edinburgh) - and they were removed from this file rather than duplicated. No venue in this file collides with any existing census record on name+city. OPERATOR PORTFOLIOS CHECKED AND RECONCILED LINE BY LINE: ATG Entertainment (full UK list via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ambassador_Theatre_Group - ALL 33 UK venues already in the census, zero gaps); Trafalgar Entertainment / former HQ Theatres (19 UK venues via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trafalgar_Entertainment - 6 gaps found and added: Congress Theatre, Winter Garden Eastbourne, G Live, Fareham Live, Pavilion Theatre Glasgow, Bradford Live); Nimax Theatres (only the Palace Theatre is >= 1,000 and it is already present); LW Theatres / Really Useful Group (all six >= 1,000 houses already present); Delfont Mackintosh (all six >= 1,000 houses already present); Nederlander UK (Adelphi, Aldwych, Dominion all present); Academy Music Group (full venue table via en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Music_Group - 10 gaps >= 1,000 added; O2 Academy Glasgow, O2 Shepherd’s Bush Empire and Newcastle City Hall were already present); AEG (The Halls Wolverhampton added; The O2, OVO Arena Wembley, Eventim Apollo already present; indigo at The O2 added as a distinct room); NEC Group (NEC, ICC, Symphony Hall, Utilita Arena Birmingham, bp pulse LIVE all present); ASM Global / Sheffield Theatres / Birmingham Hippodrome / Capital Theatres / Bradford Theatres (no >= 1,000 gaps found). POPULATIONS SWEPT: (a) en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_End_theatre full capacity table - every West End house at or above 1,000 seats was already in the census, so the suspected West End gap does not exist; (b) the complete "Indoor theatres and halls" table of en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_venues_in_the_United_Kingdom read as raw wikitext and filtered to >= 1,000; (c) a Wikidata SPARQL capacity query (P1083 >= 1000, P131* within England/Scotland/Wales/Northern Ireland) returning 864 rows, of which 86 distinct performance-venue-typed records were cross-checked; (d) MediaWiki revisions-API retrieval of 210 individual venue articles for infobox capacity, address, owner and operator; (e) 230 direct fetches of official venue and local-authority sites for first-party capacity and what’s-on pages. LARGE LOCAL-AUTHORITY ESTATES CHECKED: Croydon, Watford, St Albans, Tunbridge Wells, Eastbourne, Hastings, Bexhill (Rother), Wolverhampton, Blackburn with Darwen, Preston, Warrington, Carlisle, Middlesbrough, Kirklees, Calderdale, North Lincolnshire, East Lindsey, Harrogate/North Yorkshire, Scarborough, Cornwall, BCP/Poole, Portsmouth, Guildford, Fareham, Peterborough, Glasgow Life, City of Edinburgh, Aberdeen City, Stirling, Renfrewshire, Denbighshire, Belfast. NATIONS: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland were swept deliberately and separately rather than as a by-product of a London/England sweep. CAPACITY RULE APPLIED: the principal capacity_value is always a single main auditorium, never a sum of a building’s rooms; secondary rooms go to additional_capacities. Where a venue is admitted on a standing rather than seated configuration (Alban Arena, Engine Shed, Exeter Great Hall) that is stated explicitly in capacity_configuration. DELIBERATE EXCLUSIONS ON EVIDENCE: Royal Hall Harrogate was investigated and EXCLUDED because the official Harrogate Convention Centre venue page states a theatre capacity of 978, below the 1,000 threshold. O2 Academy Edinburgh was EXCLUDED because its AMG slug returned HTTP 404 when probed live, indicating it is no longer an operating AMG venue, despite appearing in the AMG Wikipedia table at 3,000. Sub-1,000 houses confirmed and skipped include Gielgud (994), Noel Coward (942), Lyric Shaftesbury Avenue (915), Wyndham’s (799), Theatre Royal Haymarket (888), Sheffield Crucible (980), Orchard Theatre Dartford (956), Churchill Theatre Bromley (785), Devonshire Park Theatre (873), Cheltenham Town Hall (978), Weymouth Pavilion (988) and Queen’s Hall Edinburgh (801). HONEST NULLS: seven venues are recorded with capacity_value null and capacity_confidence CAPACITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED (Hall for Cornwall, Huddersfield Town Hall, Parr Hall, The Sands Centre, Albert Halls Stirling, Paisley Town Hall, Rhyl Pavilion Theatre) because no fetched page stated a figure. They are NOT asserted to meet the >= 1,000 threshold. SHARED CALENDAR PLATFORMS RECORDED: academymusicgroup.com/<venue-slug>/events (11 live slugs confirmed by live HTTP probe; pattern opened in a real browser at O2 Academy Brixton and confirmed to render named dated events); trafalgartickets.com/<venue-slug>/en-GB (4 venues here, covering 5 auditoria); betterboxoffice.co.uk/<venue-slug> (GLL/Better); everyonetheatres.com/theatres/<venue-slug>/ (Everyone Active); bwdvenues.com (Blackburn with Darwen, multi-venue); boxoffice.middlesbrough.gov.uk (Middlesbrough, multi-venue); glasgowlife.org.uk/whats-on/glasgow-life-tickets (Glasgow Life, multi-venue); scunthorpetheatres.co.uk (North Lincolnshire, multi-venue); eastbournetheatres.co.uk via trafalgartickets (multi-venue).
